entities.summary: Qajar, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Afsharid, Zand, and Qajar Iran (1794–1906). Preceded by Constitutional Revolution and Nadir Shah sacks Delhi and seizes the Peacock Throne and Koh-i-Noor diamond. Their legacy influenced Treaties of Gulistan (1813) and Turkmenchay (1828) cede the Caucasus to Russia and Tobacco Protest — first successful mass movement against foreign concessions.
